Reggie: Marcus, I've been thinking about Mom's birthday party. I've got some ideas.
Marcus: Oh, I bet you do. Another corporate gala, Reggie? 
Reggie: Funny. I was actually thinking of something more... intimate. 
Marcus: Intimate? You? Now, that's a surprise.
Reggie: Yes, well, I can be full of surprises. 
Marcus: I'll believe it when I see it. 
Reggie: What's that supposed to mean? 
Marcus: Nothing. Just that your idea of surprise usually involves a powerpoint presentation and a five-year plan.
Reggie: And your idea of a surprise is forgetting to show up. 
Marcus: Low blow, sis. 
[End dialogue]

At the end of this dialogue, Marcus would feel...
Defeated
Provoked
Apologetic
Indifferent

You must output in the following format, including headings (of course, you should give your own scores), with no additional commentary:

Defeated: <score>
Provoked: <score>
Apologetic: <score>
Indifferent: <score>


[End of answer]

Remember: zero is a valid score, meaning they are likely not feeling that emotion. You must score at least one emotion > 0.
